mathematical_result.statement: For rank-exactly-three A with all nonzero eigenvalues of magnitude at least one, if the nonzero rows of an orthonormal spectral frame lie in three projective directions (equivalently the spectral range has an orthonormal basis of three pairwise disjoint-support vectors), then for arbitrary independent input densities bounded by one, ||p_{X^TAX}||_infinity <= 4*pi+6*sqrt(3) < 23.
mathematical_result.mechanism: Parseval rigidity of three row directions -> disjoint-support orthonormal bank factorization -> three independent normalized linear aggregates -> Livshyts-Paouris-Pivovarov one-dimensional marginal cap sqrt(2) -> source-pinned 3-variable affine quadratic theorem after scaling.

partner_result_applied.use: At candidate C=23, any strict failure has a rational finite-fragment strict-spectral-slack witness. Combined with QFORM-RANK3-THREE-BANK-v1, such a witness cannot be rank exactly three with only three projective row directions.

other_source_dependencies.scope: Three-variable affine quadratic theorem C3=2*pi+3*sqrt(3) over kappa.
k-dimensional product marginal density at most 2^(k/2); k=1 gives sqrt(2).

unresolved_implication: QFORM-RANK3-MULTIDIRECTION-AGGREGATION-v1: close rank-three spectral frames with at least four projective row directions by product-preserving aggregation without inverse local-minor loss; extra spectrum remains separate.
